notes.title: Rain threat in Melbourne
notes.text: The Bureau of Meteorology forecast a 70% chance of showers on match day, most likely in the late afternoon and evening. Both teams' final warm-up games in Brisbane earlier in the week were washed out.

notes.title: Shan Masood cleared after a blow to the head
notes.text: Pakistan's Shan Masood was struck on the head by a ball in the nets at the MCG on 21 October. A CT scan showed only superficial bruising and he was cleared to play.

notes.title: Fakhar Zaman's knee
notes.text: Fakhar Zaman was added to Pakistan's 15 on 14 October while still recovering from a knee injury picked up at the Asia Cup, and was reported unavailable for this game.

notes.title: India without Bumrah and Jadeja
notes.text: India are without Jasprit Bumrah and Ravindra Jadeja through injury; Axar Patel fills the left-arm spin all-rounder role.

notes.title: The MCG
notes.text: The Melbourne Cricket Ground is one of the largest cricket grounds in the world, with long square boundaries.
